# Areas of Effect

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md)*

The Area of Effect rules and every shape tagged [Area of Effect].

## Entries

- [Area of Effect](Area-of-Effect.md): The descriptions of many spells and other features specify that they have an area of effect, which typically has one of six shapes.
- [Cone [Area of Effect]](Cone.md): A Cone is an area of effect that extends in straight lines from a point of origin in a direction its creator chooses.
- [Cube [Area of Effect]](Cube.md): A Cube is an area of effect that extends in straight lines from a point of origin located anywhere on a face of the Cube.
- [Cylinder [Area of Effect]](Cylinder.md): A Cylinder is an area of effect that extends in straight lines from a point of origin located at the center of the circular top or bottom of the Cylinder.
- [Emanation [Area of Effect]](Emanation.md): An Emanation is an area of effect that extends in straight lines from a creature or an object in all directions.
- [Line [Area of Effect]](Line.md): A Line is an area of effect that extends from a point of origin in a straight path along its length and covers an area defined by its width.
- [Sphere [Area of Effect]](Sphere.md): A Sphere is an area of effect that extends in straight lines from a point of origin outward in all directions.
